inputs.text: Canada is right to put its own people and public order first. With Bill C-12 receiving royal assent on March 26, 2026, tighter rules for Nigerians and others send a necessary message: immigration and asylum must be governed by law, not sentiment. A country that fails to enforce its borders risks losing public trust and weakening the social order that holds communities together.
